Holding down the trigger progressively grants up to 60% increased Rate of Fire and ? Range after 1.38 seconds. 

As long as the trigger continues to be held, an explosive projectile is added every 18 shots, dealing <pve 56 /> <pvp [21] /> damage with no damage falloff. 

Achieving maximum fire rate increases the frequency of these projectiles to once every 8 shots.
